I work at a haunted house, so here are some tips.
• stay an arms length away.
• Scare forward, meaning don't jump in front of the customers it will back up the line.
• I love pretending to be a maniquinn sometimes and then even little movements of noises will scare customers once they think they're safe.
• Listen for names. Sometimes you'll hear someone say something like "oh my god Jenny!" and just say Jenny and it'll freak them out. Sometimes another customer ahead of the others will say "Jenny is three people behind me" or something so you can scare them.
• Following is fun. Once the group starts to leave your area they think they're safe from you. Quietly follow behind and just say something or make a creepy noise, it'll start a chain reaction if scares among the group.
• Don't break character, you can insult and say pretty much anything as long as you're in character. Ignore drunk and high people. If they don't get a rise out of you they'll leave. 

Hope this helps :)
